entries.name: calendar_to_ganzhi
entries.precondition: external calendar time-to-ganzhi derivation is available

entries.name: determine_active_solar_term
entries.precondition: verified solar-term instant and date available
entries.operation: Select relevant term and its Yin/Yang and three yuan values.

entries.name: day_futou
entries.operation: Backtrack to nearest Jia/Ji day and classify yuan using that day's branch.

entries.name: bureau_lookup
entries.operation: Read Yin/Yang and bureau upper/middle/lower triad.

entries.name: ground_plate
entries.operation: Lay out Wu Ji Geng Xin Ren Gui Ding Bing Yi around 1..9 ascending/descending.

entries.name: hour_local_branch
entries.precondition: local clock and explicit day-boundary policy

entries.name: hour_stem_five_rat
entries.precondition: known day stem and hour branch
entries.operation: Choose Zi-hour stem and increment through 12 branches.

entries.name: jia_hidden_instrument
entries.operation: Map six Jia hidden under six instruments and find original earth palace.

entries.name: value_star_and_door
entries.operation: Read fixed star and fixed door, with palace-5 special handling.

entries.name: value_star_tracks_hour_stem
entries.precondition: hour heavenly stem assigned to ground palace
entries.operation: Move value star and its attached earth instrument to hour-stem ground palace.

entries.name: all_stars_rotate
entries.precondition: value star target on outer palace, host policy if center
entries.operation: Rotate rest of stars around outer ring preserving relative positions; center TianQin travels with TianRui.

entries.name: value_door_tracks_hourly_palace_number
entries.precondition: xun-head palace and hours since Jia
entries.operation: From xun-head palace, count hourly 1..9 forward in Yang or backward in Yin.
entries.exception: If the timed value door counts into middle 5, place it at Kun-2 host; leave center free of ordinary door
entries.implementation_revision: 2026-10-29 verified Zhuanpan variant continuation; ancient chapter source lines retained, variant scope audited separately

entries.name: remaining_doors_rotate
entries.precondition: value door target and original door host
entries.operation: Rotate remaining seven doors preserving clockwise ring order.
entries.exception: If the timed value door counts into middle 5, place it at Kun-2 host; leave center free of ordinary door
entries.implementation_revision: 2026-10-29 verified Zhuanpan variant continuation; ancient chapter source lines retained, variant scope audited separately

entries.name: eight_deities_track_value_star
entries.precondition: actual target palace of value star
entries.operation: Small value deity begins with great value star, Yang clockwise, Yin counterclockwise.
